Cost Per Dose: 50eb (Costly)

A 2020s oldie that pushes the limit of hallucinogenics. Typically applied directly to the skin like an ointment, and more typically results in its user’s nervous system collapsing just before their mind does the same.

⋙ PRIMARY EFFECT ⋘

  • Lasts 5 minutes.
  • For the duration of the Primary Effect, the user is subjected to intense hallucinations that massively distort their sense of reality, reduce their inhibitions, and make it difficult for them to remember who they are and where they are. For this duration, the GM may occasionally inform the user they are ‘spinning out’ and thus lose their ability to take an Action on their Turn.
  • For the duration of the Primary Effect, the user’s EMP is considered 2 higher (Max EMP 8) for the purposes of Humanity (but not for other purposes such as Skill Checks) and its effects (CP:R, pg. 232). This can prevent a character from becoming a Cyberpsycho, but only so long as the Primary Duration lasts.

⋙ SECONDARY EFFECT (DV19) ⋘

  • The user takes 3 points of Humanity Loss.
  • If the user wasn’t already addicted to RPM, they are now. While addicted, the user’s REF is permanently decreased by 2.

NOTE: This drug is based on a comment Johnny Silverhand makes during the Disasterpiece side quest in Cyberpunk 2077 when observing some drugs the Scavs are making. Mechanically though, it’s loosely based on the Cyberpunk 2013 drug it’s likely a reference to, which is from the non-canon When Gravity Fails sourcebook.

“Smells like propylmethionine. Must be cookin' RPM here.”

“Ah, RPM. Used to sprinkle it on my breakfast.”

— V & Johnny Silverhand

Cost: 50eb (Costly) per dose
Type: Street Drug

Foundry notes:

  • While addicted, switch on the "RPM Addiction" effect.
  • Stat and skill changes are automated; caps, minimums, durations, and everything else are not.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > Consumables > Street Drugs).
